text.p: Walshire Assurance Co said Thursday that Alex. Brown & Sons will help it review strategic alternatives in order to maximize shareholders value.
The company said in a statement it had expanded its engagement with the firm to include assisting its board of directors in reviewing the alternatives, including the possible sale of the company.
It also reported a profit of $0.07 on revenues of $13.2 million for the second quarter against $0.27 on $13.0 million for the same period last year.
Walshire specializes in property casualty and insurance services.
